content.user_title: Make AI Responses Easier to Act On
content.value_statement: Long or indirect AI responses can make starting and tracking work difficult. This skill presents clear actions, bounded steps, visible progress, and concrete estimates.
actual_capabilities: Leads responses with an immediately actionable next step.
Organizes multi-step work as numbered, bounded actions.
Restates current progress and the next step across turns.
Replaces vague effort estimates with concrete time ranges.
Separates tangential issues until the current task is complete.
Adjusts formatting for explanations, ambiguity, destructive actions, and repeated debugging failures.
limitations: Does not diagnose, treat, or provide medical advice about ADHD.
Does not execute commands or complete tasks without the host agent's tools.
Depends on the model and host application following the formatting instructions.
May be unsuitable when a task requires uninterrupted narrative or extensive background first.

use_cases.title: Complete a Coding Fix
use_cases.description: Turn debugging guidance into short numbered actions with progress restated after each result.

use_cases.title: Manage Administrative Work
use_cases.description: Break a complex office task into a small current action and a clearly separated later list.

use_cases.title: Structure Study Sessions
use_cases.description: Convert a broad learning goal into concrete steps with realistic time estimates and visible completion points.

prompt_templates.title: Start ADHD-Friendly Mode
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the i-have-adhd skill. Help me complete [task], starting with one action I can do now.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for direct task support

prompt_templates.title: Rewrite Existing Guidance
prompt_templates.prompt: Rewrite the following guidance for an ADHD reader. Lead with the next action, use bounded steps, and remove tangents: [text]
prompt_templates.scenario: Convert a long response into an actionable format

prompt_templates.title: Track a Multi-Step Project
prompt_templates.prompt: Guide me through [project]. Show no more than five current steps, restate our status each turn, and separate optional work.
prompt_templates.scenario: Maintain progress across a longer conversation

prompt_templates.title: Control a Debugging Spiral
prompt_templates.prompt: We tried [attempts] and the issue remains. Identify the weakest assumption, ask one diagnostic question, and preserve all safety confirmations.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced debugging after repeated unsuccessful changes

output_examples.input: Help me prepare the monthly report. I have notes but have not started.
output_examples.output: Open the notes and write the report title. Then group the notes under results, risks, and next actions. Estimated time: 20 minutes.

output_examples.input: The login test still fails after three different fixes.
output_examples.output: Stop changing the implementation. Weak assumption: the test request includes valid credentials. Next: confirm the request headers from the failing test.

output_examples.input: Explain several options for organizing this project.
output: Recommended: organize by outcome because each section has a clear completion condition.
Alternative: organize by deadline when scheduling risk is the main concern.
Alternative: organize by owner when coordination is the main concern.

best_practices: State the desired result and the current blocker.
Share completed steps so the skill can restate accurate progress.
Request a full explanation explicitly when background detail is important.
anti_patterns: Do not use the skill as a substitute for medical care or diagnosis.
Do not omit safety checks to make instructions shorter.
Do not expect persistence outside the current agent session.

faq.question: Does this skill provide medical advice?
faq.answer: No. It changes response structure and does not diagnose or treat ADHD.

faq.question: How do I activate the skill?
faq.answer: Invoke the skill by name or use the configured command for your supported agent.

faq.question: How do I stop the formatting mode?
faq.answer: Say "stop adhd mode" or "normal mode" during the current session.

faq.question: Will it make every response very short?
faq.answer: No. Explanations can remain detailed, but they use clear headers and actionable structure.

faq.question: Does it execute the commands it suggests?
faq.answer: No. Execution depends on the host agent, available tools, permissions, and user confirmation requirements.

faq.question: Does it override safety or system instructions?
faq.answer: No. The skill explicitly preserves destructive-action confirmations and higher-priority harness instructions.
